Name: Xiddav's Parks - Backwoods
Author: xiddav
Description:
Xiddav's Backwoods Expansion makes the backwoods area slightly bigger and adds more areas. 

Instead of taking you right to the Mountain, there is a long path in-between the Backwoods and Mountain.
There is also a little area that becomes available when you do the community upgrade for shortcuts. This area contains a tower with six floors that loop. Casks and beds can be placed in the tower, but be careful. The tower seems to have a spider infestation.




"Is it compatible with SVE?"
I didn't test it, but probably not.

"Will you make it compatible with SVE?"
No.
SVE doesn't run well for me so it's hard to test. I make mods for myself and share them with others. The effort to make it work with SVE can be spent on working on my other mods.

"What about other mods?"
Let me know what they are and I'll look into possible compatibility.
